title: CHROMIUM B.S.U.
subtitle: Mark B. Allan, 2000; Paul Wise, 0.9.16.1 (2016) · C++ on SDL 1.2, OpenGL and GLU, its text through FTGL over FreeType

needsData.hint: the game's data as `make install` lays it out, from the root: usr/local/share/chromium-bsu/{png,wav} from chromium-bsu-0.9.16.1.tar.gz, and usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf (the font its configure named)

_why: A whole C++ game with its libraries compiled from source beside it: FTGL (C++) and FreeType for its text, GLU 9's tessellator for FTGL's outlines, zlib and libjpeg. It opens its data at the absolute paths its configure wrote (PKGDATADIR, FONT_PATH), so the data root is mounted at / and stdio matches paths exactly (`mount`, `exactPaths`): a basename guess answered stat() for one file with another of the same name.
